<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Dedication" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=572" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 82

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
you have permanent wings (such as from an ancestry or graft)

</column>

---

Through rigorous training, you have strengthened your wings, granting you enough thrust to gain additional altitude. When you make a horizontal [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=2298), increase the distance by 10 feet up to a maximum of your Speed. Any fly Speed granted by ancestry feats and other permanent wings increases by 5 feet.

<title level="2">Winged Warrior Dedication leads to...</title>
[Battering Wings](/Feats.aspx?ID=5528), [Bombing Run](/Feats.aspx?ID=5539), [Cratering Drop](/Feats.aspx?ID=5540), [Falcon Swoop](/Feats.aspx?ID=5535), [Feathered Flechettes](/Feats.aspx?ID=5532), [Gusting Spell](/Feats.aspx?ID=5529), [Pluck From the Sky](/Feats.aspx?ID=5533), [Redirecting Draft](/Feats.aspx?ID=5536), [Smooth Hover](/Feats.aspx?ID=5537), [Sonic Strafe](/Feats.aspx?ID=5541), [Sunbird Glare](/Feats.aspx?ID=5531), [Thunderous Landing](/Feats.aspx?ID=5538), [Wing Bounce](/Feats.aspx?ID=5530), [Wing Shove](/Feats.aspx?ID=5534)
